prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1302; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and reduced motion in the right shoulder. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the shoulder complaints recorded at intake. Over seven visits, care consisted of physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and periodic reassessment. Recovery was somewhat slower than typically seen with this type of injury, and the course of treatment extended beyond the usual timeframe. Examination revealed limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff, which support the reported injury. Other provocative tests and neurological screening were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. Continued home exercise and follow-up are recommended, with return to full activity anticipated as strength and mobility improve.
